run_pc_pre_validation_cli: run the CLI to validate input data for private computations with cloud provider and region args
run_main_function: run the main function to parse docopt arguments and execute InputDataValidator and BinaryFileValidator
run_validators_runner: run the validators_runner to aggregate results from InputDataValidator and BinaryFileValidator
create_input_data_validator: create an InputDataValidator instance with input file path, cloud provider, region, and optional TEE settings
create_binary_file_validator: create a BinaryFileValidator instance with region, access keys, and optional binary version
